evidence_signal: MotionIQ/Health monitors steering, chassis components, and tires, and ties this to fleet downtime reduction, maintenance scheduling, and diagnostic time reduction.
supports: 操舵系を含むchassis healthがfleet downtime / maintenance schedulingの文脈で売られている。
limits: 製品発表であり、実顧客導入・支払額・対象車種は見えない。
confidence: High for market signal / Medium for paid demand

evidence_signal: Nexteer says connected vehicle technology and longer ownership cycles create demand for prognostics; fleet uptime and longevity are highlighted.
supports: 商用fleetではuptimeと長期稼働がhealth monitoring需要の芯になる。
limits: steering-specific failure frequencyや実運用停止事例は示されていない。

evidence_signal: Bosch positions cloud/predictive diagnostics for logistics companies and mobility service providers to identify vehicle issues before they impact operations.
supports: fleetのreliability / efficiency / operational impactが需要として明示される。
limits: steering単体ではなくvehicle fleet全体の診断。
confidence: High for fleet demand / Low for EPS-specific demand

evidence_signal: Waymo says Ryder partnership is for autonomous truck maintenance best practices to maximize uptime and reliability.
supports: 自動運転truckではmaintenance practiceとuptimeが運行価値に直結する。
limits: 操舵系の痛みではなく、maintenance全体の話。
confidence: High for AV maintenance demand / Low for steering specificity

evidence_signal: Ryder technicians embedded in Aurora terminal to maximize utilization of autonomous trucks.
supports: AV truckの運行ではon-site maintenanceとutilizationが重要。
limits: 操舵系ではなくtruck全体。

evidence_signal: FleetME connects vehicle data, diagnostics, OEM maintenance schedules, repair guidance, and parts in a unified platform for fleet maintenance.
supports: 買い手候補はfleet maintenance owner、OEM service、platform ownerで、出力はmaintenance scheduling / repair guidance。
limits: EPS/SbWサプライヤが直接買い手になるとは言えない。
confidence: High for buyer workflow / Medium for supplier role

evidence_signal: Geotab describes fleet managers using active diagnostic faults and critical engine data to identify issues and prioritize repairs.
supports: 利用者はfleet manager / maintenance plannerで、repair priorityが業務出力になる。
limits: engine data中心で、steering/chassisの優先度は弱い。
confidence: High for workflow / Low for EPS specificity

evidence_signal: International reports active fault codes and performance data via portal, mobile app, reports, and API connections into fleet platforms.
supports: OEM/fleet service部門がconnected diagnosticsの買い手・運用主体になりうる。
limits: 対象はInternational truck ecosystemで、EPS supplier boundaryは不明。

evidence_signal: Nexteer says MotionIQ/Health can use anonymized data from actual lifecycle conditions for OEM and supplier product quality/development insights.
supports: サプライヤが実使用データloopに入る公開例として強い。
limits: 匿名化・契約・データ項目・service history/交換結果へのアクセスは不明。

evidence_signal: High Mobility provides fleet APIs and notes brand partnerships enabling access to connected vehicle data such as journey history and tyre pressures.
supports: OEM/fleet data accessの市場インフラは存在する。
limits: EPS DTC/DID、整備履歴、交換結果へのアクセスは示さない。

evidence_signal: The article emphasizes collaboration among vehicle manufacturers, suppliers, and regulators, plus data privacy and standards as challenges.
supports: AV predictive maintenanceにはsupplier collaborationが必要という方向はある。
limits: 講演紹介記事であり、実契約やEPS supplier data accessの証明ではない。
confidence: Medium for collaboration need / Low for access proof

evidence_signal: Remote data can confirm sensor failure, support parts preparation, match repair specialists, and evaluate if a driver should return to garage immediately.
supports: 価値ある出力は交換時期ではなく、今戻すか、部品準備、修理手配、優先度判断。
limits: 例はengine/sensor中心で、steering-specificではない。
confidence: High for decision output / Low for EPS specificity

evidence_signal: Remote diagnostics helps understand thousands of fault codes and prioritize repairs through health reports, action plans, and alerts.
supports: 運行・整備判断に転記できる出力はrepair prioritizationである。
limits: 既存remote diagnosticsが既に一般層を押さえている可能性がある。

evidence_signal: Volvo positions remote diagnostics as maximizing uptime, avoiding unexpected downtime, and reducing diagnostic time by more than 70%.
supports: 診断時間短縮と稼働時間最大化が買われる文脈。
limits: engine/I-Shift/aftertreatment中心で、steeringは含まれない。

evidence_signal: Current OBD is described as reactive and not equipped for AV complexity; predictive maintenance needs richer data, standards, and collaboration.
supports: 通常OBD/DTCだけではAVの運行判断に不足する可能性がある。
limits: steering単体の不足ではなく、AV sensor/compute/cyberを含む広い話。

evidence_signal: Commercial vehicles can generate thousands of fault codes; telematics-based remote diagnostics makes faults understandable and repair-prioritizable.
supports: raw DTCだけでは運行・整備優先度に変換しにくいことを示す。
limits: Geotabのような既存platformで足りる可能性も同時に示す。
confidence: High for raw-DTC insufficiency / Medium as kill risk

evidence_signal: Remote diagnostics transmits performance data to an uptime network and reduces diagnostic time.
supports: DTC後の診断時間短縮が価値として存在する。
limits: 既存OEM remote diagnosticsの守備範囲であり、EPS supplierの差分は未確認。

evidence_signal: Bosch Engineering says EPS enables highly automated driving up to SAE L4 and that HAD/SbW systems use redundant safeguards for safety-critical aspects.
supports: 操舵系は自動運転の重要部品で、冗長・高可用の論点がある。
limits: これは安全設計の根拠であり、整備判断需要の証明ではない。

evidence_signal: Bosch fail-operational EPS detects steering failure and moves to electrical fallback, allowing highly automated vehicles to reach a safe stop.
supports: SbW/HADではdegraded/fallback stateが運行可否・整備優先度の入力候補になる。
limits: 製品安全説明であり、fleet maintenance商品需要ではない。

evidence_signal: MotionIQ suite streamlines chassis control, development, and vehicle health-monitoring workflows for OEMs across automotive, off-road, commercial vehicle, and adjacent mobility sectors.
supports: EPS単体より、chassis / motion healthの束として見る方が公開signalに合う。
limits: 具体的なhealth対象・顧客導入は限定的にしか見えない。
